description:
Values for the Rust tests of kaula_planet.rs (phase E, plan_phaseE.md section 6, tests R3 and R4).

Produced by the validated Python implementations:
  * checks/ch8_forms.py  (same implementation as reference_values/kaula_l2_reference_cases.json)
  * verif/tex_forms.py   (transcription of equations_nbody.tex: Tisserand's formula)
  * checks/kaula_lib.py  (Hansen coefficients by quadrature, independent of Tisserand)

Outputs (reference_values/):
  kaula_l2_random_states.json   R3: 60 random states (r, v, s), 3 spectra, e in [0, 0.5), i in [0, pi]
  kaula_planet_unit_values.json R4: F_2mp(i), G_2pq(e), spectrum evaluations, q_max table

love_number_spectrum.formula: rek2 = k2 cos(chi dt), imk2 = k2 sin(chi dt), chi in rad/s
rek2 = k2/(1+(chi tau)^2), imk2 = k2 chi tau/(1+(chi tau)^2), chi in rad/s

love_number_spectrum.note: linear interpolation inside, extrapolation rule of Section 8.4 outside; the table is included below so that the case is self-contained
